th 02/Dated: 05 June, 2025 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. The petitioner has moved before this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail from
apprehending her arrest instituted under Sections 408/420/467/468/471/120B of the Ipc.
3.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has falsely been implicated in the present case.
It is submitted that there is no any money paid to the petitioner and there is no agreement between them.
It is further submitted that when the informant demanded money the petitioner has abused her and except there is no allegation against her.
He lastly submits that the allegation made against her is false and purposely concocted by the informant.

4. Learned A.P.P. opposed the prayer for bail.
5. Having regard to the facts of the case, I am inclined to grant privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, the petitioner is directed to surrender in the Court below within four weeks from today and in the event of her arrest or surrender, she will be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/- (Rupees Twenty thousand Only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned J.M.F.C. Ranchi in connection with Sukhdev Nagar P.S. Case No.525/2024 with the condition that she will co- operate with the investigation of the case and appear before the investigating officer as and when noticed by him and furnish her mobile number and photocopy of the Aadhaar Card with an undertaking that she will not change her mobile number during the pendency of the case and subject to the conditions as laid down under Page | 1 2025:JHHC:14552 Section 482(2) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
It is made clear that if the petitioner does not cooperate with the investigation/trial, the State would be at liberty to take appropriate action.
(Deepak Roshan, J.) Sandeep/Rahul Page | 2 Kumari Suman Singh @ Suman Singh vs The State Of Jharkhand .
